# Week 9 Test

This is an exam week for this module. The exam will last for 45 min on Moodle. There are 20 questions of 20 points in total. The pass mark is 8 points (40%). The pass mark is quite low given the level of the questions. Therefore, I don't expect to see fails on this test unless you have never attempted any of the weekly problems/exercises. Furthermore the test contain questions of the weekly test questions.

::: callout-important
Make sure you don't miss out your examinations as they are mandatory for the completion of your module.
:::

Now, go to Moodle, and click the link \`Week 9 Test\`

Alternatively, if you are connected to the internet campus, you can directly click this link [Week 9 Test](https://modules.lancaster.ac.uk/mod/quiz/view.php?id=2468619)
